summary: Wrote a 6-phase implementation plan integrating the research report's confirmed mechanism and its one refutation. The plan lands both recommended fixes: (a) a source-store-only sync-manifest-scripts.sh with --check/--write modes deriving provides.scripts from each extension's tracked scripts/ tree, and (b) a new deploy_baseline_self_attributable_findings partition wired into the temporally-pre-existing branch (c) at BOTH baseline call sites, so a finding naming a completing task's own modified_files can no longer be waved through. Phase 4 pins both mechanisms behaviorally (including Rule Q's first-ever fixture coverage and a negative proof), Phase 5 documents the provides.scripts-vs-index-entries asymmetry plus the uncovered agents/commands/context gap, Phase 6 redeploys and runs the full gate set.

artifacts.summary: 6-phase plan: provides.scripts automation plus a self-attribution screen on the baseline-tolerant completion branch, with fixtures and docs.
